questions.question: Which ISO standard is internationally recognized for Quality Management Systems (QMS)?

options.B: ISO 9001

questions.question: What is the physical significance of Net Positive Suction Head (NPSH) available?

options.A: To make the results look better
options.B: To drastically reduce the number of elements and nodes, saving computational time and memory without losing accuracy

options.B: A dynamic motion constraint

questions.question: What defines a 'Black Body' in radiation heat transfer?

Over the past six months, the company has experienced rapid growth in bookings but is facing significant HR challenges. Employee turnover among front desk executives, housekeeping staff, and customer service associates has increased to 25%. Employee feedback indicates concerns about irregular work schedules, limited career growth opportunities, and insufficient training. Customer complaints regarding service quality have also risen by 15%, affecting the hotel's online ratings. Competitors in the area are offering better employee benefits and structured training programs. The founder, Ankit, has a limited HR budget and must decide whether to invest in employee training, introduce performance incentives, improve work-life balance, or strengthen recruitment processes.
